svg.title: Chain: three plugins in one worker
svg.desc: The daemon adds three plugins, each in a worker of its own, then the chain command moves them into one worker. Inside that worker an amber chain holds omx-comp, omx-delay and omx-drive in series. The daemon stays outside the JACK graph and only sends commands.
